dct_description_sm:
This is an old dataset.  Use the Peel Ward Boundary dataset for up to date ward boundaries and representatives.  Contains ward boundaries within the Region of Peel for the 2018-2022 term of council. Municipal elections are levied at the Ward level; councillors are elected from each ward to form Municipal and Regional councils.

There are two files provided in this package:
  1. WardBoundary_20182022 - the Regional Ward boundaries with Councillor name and contact information.
  2. WardBoundary_20182022_Represent - this table follows the OpenNorth Represent format for their Represent API.  It provides additional contact and contextual information that is used by the API.
